decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The setup of the car has been changed while under Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: BWT Alpine F1 Team changed the setup of Car 43 under Parc Ferme, without the approval of the Technical Delegate. The car is therefore required to start the Race from pit lane as per Article 40.9 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 43 Changes Made During Parc Ferme
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine Formula 1 Team
